summary: PO 2023 section 8: language practice in the chosen language area (modules 1 and 2 for French or for Spanish, 12 ECTS), compulsory module 3 (14 ECTS), module 4a or 4b by profile (12 ECTS), a 16-ECTS research or practice project, five 6-ECTS economics modules (30 ECTS), 7 ECTS key competencies (3 additive plus 4 integrated in the project module; Modul 6 lists the 3-ECTS methods seminar and the 3 additive ECTS) and the 30-ECTS thesis.
